salary_details.details: The pay, allowances and other terms and conditions of the official appointed on deputation will be governed by the provisions laid down in O.M. No.13/4/74-PER Dated 20/11/2013, as amended from time to time.

selection_process: The declaration in Annexure-I states that the information furnished by the applicant will be assessed by the Selection Committee at the time of selection. The notice does not mention a written test or interview.
how_to_apply: Fill in the prescribed proforma, Annexure-I, given with the vacancy circular.

In Annexure-I, give your name (in block letters), address, date of birth, date of entry into service, date of retirement, educational qualification, experience and your employment record in chronological order.
In the employment table, list the name of department, post held on regular basis, period of the post held, Pay Level/Pay Band + Grade Pay, and nature of duties handled.
Sign the declaration and add your name, address, mobile number and email.
Submit the application through proper channel to your Head of Department/PSU, with relevant documents, if any.
The Head of Department/PSU verifies and certifies the particulars and that no disciplinary proceedings are pending or contemplated, and forwards the application.
The application must reach The Secretary, Goa Staff Selection Commission, 6th Floor, 3rd Lift, SPACES Building, Patto Plaza, Panaji-Goa on or before 04/12/2026.
Application in the prescribed proforma Annexure-I with the requisite personal data
Certification by the forwarding authority on correctness of particulars and absence of pending or contemplated disciplinary proceedings
important_instructions: Appointment is on deputation basis initially for one year, which may be extended from time to time as per the rules. Only recommendations/applications accompanied by the requisite personal data in Annexure-I will be considered. Applications received after the last date or found incomplete will not be considered. All Heads of Departments/PSUs are requested to give wide publicity to the circular among officials and staff under their administrative control. The circular is signed by Siddhesh L. Shetkar, Under Secretary - I. GSSC contact: Tel. No. 0832 2437260, Email ID: [email protected].

content_sections.heading: About GSSC
content_sections.text: The Goa Staff Selection Commission is an autonomous body set up under the Goa Staff Selection Commission Act, 2019. Its office is on the 6th Floor, 3rd Lift, SPACES Building, Patto Plaza, Panaji-Goa – 403001, and the Deputy Manager will work in the Commission itself.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in GSSC Deputy Manager Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 01 post of Deputy Manager at Pay Level-10 in the Goa Staff Selection Commission.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date for the GSSC Deputy Manager application?
faq.answer: Applications in Annexure-I must reach the GSSC office on or before 04/12/2026; late or incomplete applications will not be considered.

faq.question: Q3. Who can apply for the GSSC Deputy Manager post?
faq.answer: Only eligible officers working in the Government of Goa can apply, as the post is filled on deputation basis.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for GSSC Deputy Manager?
faq.answer: B.E/B. Tech. in Computer Science/ Information Technology/ Electronics Engineering OR Master Degree in Computer Science/ Computer Applications, plus 05 years experience of proficiency in the field in a Government Department/ PSU.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for GSSC Deputy Manager?
faq.answer: The applicant should not be more than 56 years of age as on the last date of receipt of application.

faq.question: Q6. What is the pay for GSSC Deputy Manager?
faq.answer: The post is at Pay Level-10; pay and allowances follow O.M. No.13/4/74-PER Dated 20/11/2013, as amended from time to time.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for the GSSC Deputy Manager post?
faq.answer: Fill in Annexure-I and submit it through proper channel; the Head of Department/PSU forwards it with certification to The Secretary, GSSC, Panaji, to reach by 04/12/2026.

faq.question: Q8. How long is the GSSC Deputy Manager deputation?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will be appointed on deputation initially for one year, which may be extended from time to time as per the rules.
